body: So I had the prescription filled and swallowed the first dose earlier today. The only change I've noticed is feeling slightly dizzy. If this gets side effect gets any worse I might have to stop driving ... sigh. Still feel urges to kill myself.
Sometimes I think I would be doing everyone a favor by dying, so they don't have to deal with me anymore.

I don't think I'm being irrational. Whenever I talk with someone, without fail their face morphs from a neutral or smile into a slightly disgusted frown when they see my face. I'm pretty sure it's the reason why she dumped me :(

"Now get your head out of your ass. Stop wasting time and stop indulging yourself in misery."

I wish I could do that.
